contribuicoes.Name: Luck
contribuicoes.Description: Increase chances of producing and dropping high quality items by {rate}%

contribuicoes.Name: Gem Contribution
contribuicoes.Description: Whenever an adventure is completed, there is {rate}% chance a random gem is contributed. (Unique Effect)

contribuicoes.Name: Assistance
contribuicoes.Description: Whenever an adventure is completed, {rate} dusts may be contributed. (Max. 50 dusts per contribution)

contribuicoes.Name: Divine Heart
contribuicoes.Description: Increase chances of spawning high quality chests by {rate}%

contribuicoes.Name: Determination
contribuicoes.Description: {rate}% of Practice Points spent are to be converted into money income. (Unique Effect)

contribuicoes.Name: Wealth
contribuicoes.Description: Whenever an adventure is completed, {amount} golds will be contributed. (Max. 5000 golds per contribution)

contribuicoes.Name: Recruitment
contribuicoes.Description: Increases chances of dropping adventurer invitations by {rate}%.

eventos.Name: Tea Party
eventos.Description: Attracts 1 adventurer of Supporter role (10-80% increased quality chance boost) to visit the Inn. Increases all resistances for adventurers in battle. Unlocks at 'Dragon's Blessing'.

eventos.Name: Banquet
eventos.Description: Attracts 1 adventurer of Assassin role (10-80% increased quality chance boost) to visit the Inn. Increases critical damage for adventurers in battle. Unlocks at 'Dragon's Blessing'.

eventos.Name: Drumming
eventos.Description: Attracts 1 adventurer of Warrior role (10-80% increased quality chance boost) to visit the Inn. Increases agility for adventurers in battle. Unlocks at 'Dragon's Blessing'.

eventos.Name: Meditation
eventos.Description: Attracts 1 adventurer of Healer or Tank role (10-80% increased quality chance boost) to visit the Inn. Increases resilience for adventurers in battle. Unlocks at 'Dragon's Blessing'.

eventos.Name: Poetry Party
eventos.Description: Attracts 2 adventurers (10-80% increased quality chance boost) to visit the Inn. Unlocks at 'Wonderland's whispers'.

eventos.Name: Trade
eventos.Description: Enhances trading route, increase all equipment sell price by 50-250% for a period of time. Unlocks at 'Fairy's crooning'.

eventos.Name: Alchemy
eventos.Description: Makes 1-3 mystic potions, and increases output capacity for adventurers in battle. Unlocks at 'Wonderland's whispers'.

eventos.Name: Armory Research
eventos.Description: Enhances all crafting facilities, allows the next 3-12 ancient items produced by factories or furnace to have 2 extra properties. Unlocks at 'Wonderful future'.

efeitos.Name: Battle Enhancement: Attribute Boosts
efeitos.Description: Boost all party members' {type} by {value} in battle

efeitos.Name: Craft Enhancement
efeitos.Description: All equipment produced by factories or furnace can have {extra} extra properties. {total} triggers left.

efeitos.Name: Recruitment Enhancement
efeitos.Description: Increases chances of attracting high quality adventurers by {rate}%. {total} triggers left.

efeitos.Name: Battle Enhancement: Output Boost
efeitos.Description: Boost all party members' output capacity by {value} in battle

barcos.Description: Large exploration boat that can carry 5 passengers. Reasonable speed

competencias.Name: Battle Skill

competencias.Name: Trade Skill
competencias.Description: Determines success rate for business encounters.

competencias.Name: Culture Skill
competencias.Description: Determines final profit rate (upon success) for business, academic and foreign fleet incidents.

competencias.Name: Research Skill
competencias.Description: Determines success rate for academic encounters.

competencias.Name: Collection Skill
competencias.Description: Determines final collection rate (upon success) for resource discovery encounters.

atributos.Name: Speed
atributos.Description: High travel speed will increase chances of entering any encounters during exploration.

atributos.Name: Food
atributos.Description: Determines the maximum number of days exploration can last, failed encounters may reduce food.

atributos.Name: Capacity
atributos.Description: Maximum number of passengers this boat may carry

encontros.Name: Resource Discovery
encontros.Description: Our exploration team discovered raw resources,

encontros.Name: Business Encounter
encontros.Description: Our exploration team made contact with foreign traders,

encontros.Name: Scholar Encounter
encontros.Description: Our exploration team met with a group of well-educated foreign researchers,

encontros.Name: Robbery
encontros.Description: Our exploration team was attacked by a group of pirates,

encontros.Name: Royal Fleet Encounter
encontros.Description: Our exploration team encountered a foreign royal fleet,

resultados.Name: Resource collection failed
resultados.Description: and was defeated by a group of keepers. We failed to collect any resources, and our boat lost {rate} food!

resultados.Name: Business encounter failed
resultados.Description: and they showed no interests in our deals due to our lack of reasonable business skills.

resultados.Name: Business encounter success
resultados.Description: and we successfully struck a deal with them and had made good profits!

resultados.Name: Scholar encounter failed
resultados.Description: and they made fun of our exploration team’s questionable academic knowledge then left.

resultados.Name: Scholar encounter success
resultados.Description: they were impressed by our scholars’ wise knowledge of the world, and made generous donations.

resultados.Name: Robbery defense failed
resultados.Description: and we failed to defend them. Our boat lost {rate} food!

resultados.Name: Robbery success
resultados.Description: and we successfully defended them and looted their treasures!

resultados.Name: Royal fleet encounter success: battle only
resultados.Description: we successfully defeated foreign royal fleet, and looted their treasures! Although we could have looted more if we had good translators!

resultados.Name: Royal fleet encounter fail
resultados.Description: and we were devastated by foreign royal fleet’s mighty power. As a result, we lost {rate} food!

resultados.Name: Royal fleet encounter success: complete
resultados.Description: and we successfully defeated foreign royal fleet and looted all of their precious treasures!
